newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends firmer, 3rd mth breaks 1,180.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends firmer, 3rd mth breaks 1,180.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS
Oct (3rd pos) 1,199 rgt/tonne Aug (south) 1,230 *
Open/Hi/Low 1,184/1,200/1,181 Prev close 1,212.50
Prev settlement 1,184 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices firmed further due to a weak ringgit against the dollar, and technical and refiners' buying. Trading was volatile with active buying seen in late trading. Speculation of a supportive July crop report from Ivan Wong aided prices. Oct resistance at 1,200 and support at 1,180.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Refiners seen covering and buying crude palm oil and products for nearby shipments.
"Exports are high in July and we expect August export to be around these levels," a trader said.

Cargo surveyor Caleb Brett put Malaysia's July bulk palm oil exports at 722,389 tonnes against its estimate of 634,753 tonnes for June. SGS (M) Sdn Bhd estimated Malaysia's palm oil exports for July at 710,836 tonnes against 611,368 tonnes for June.

"The ringgit fell again this morning. Prices were moving up because of currency," a trader said, adding that players are taking fresh positions on speculation that more export business will emerge due to the weaker ringgit.
"We expect more demand from Pakistan and many other major buyers. Palm oil will be more competitive," he said.
Gains, however, were limited by uncertainty in the fundamental outlook, traders said.

"Technically, third month october futures broke the 1,180 ringgit resistance level and more buying is seen," a technical analayst said. "The contract is trying to test the 1,200 ringgit. If it hits that level then we may see a small rally before some profit-taking set in."
At the close, the contract closed 15 ringgit higher at 1,199 ringgit ($455.03) a tonne.
Physicals Aug (south) was offered at 1,230 ringgit a tonne against bids of 1,225. It was traded at 1,210 and 1,225.
Aug (central) saw offers at 1,220 against bids of 1,212.50 with trades done at 1,205 and 1,210.
Sep (south) saw offers at 1,230 ringgit against bids of 1,225 with trades done at 1,220 and 1,225.
Sep (central) was offered at 1,220 against bids at 1,215.

In refined palm oil, Aug RBD palm oil was offered at $495 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Sep at $492.50 and Oct/Nov/Dec at $492.50. Aug RBD palm olein saw offers at $532.50, Sep at $530 and Oct/Nov/Dec at $530. Aug was traded from $524 to $530, Sep from $524 to $527, Oct/Nov/Dec from $522.50 to $525.
Aug/Sep RBD palm stearin was offered at $370, and Aug/Sep RBD palm fatty acid distillate saw offers at $290.
